create_CocoSegDataset: create a CocoSegDataset instance for COCO semantic segmentation with 182 classes and color palette
load_data_list_CocoSegDataset: load data list from image and segmentation map directories using CocoSegDataset
get_label_map_CocoSegDataset: get a label mapping dictionary from old to new class labels for subset training
update_palette_CocoSegDataset: update the color palette for CocoSegDataset to match a custom subset of classes
register_CocoSegDataset: register CocoSegDataset in the mmdet DATASETS registry for use in segmentation model configs
